Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh bowlers will be mentally and physically tired. They bowled just three balls short of 200 overs, that's a real tough toil to say the least. Taijul Islam got 4 wickets but he made a record of bowling the most no. of overs for a Bangladeshi bowler in the process. Right then, it's now on their batters to do the job. They don't have much time to regroup and will have to bat and bat well to overhaul the Lankans. It would be interesting to see if the visitors' spinners get any assistance off the deck. Out walk Tamim Iqbal an Imrul Kayes. The third innings is set to get underway...

Dinesh Chandimal from the dressing room says it's enough. SRI LANKA HAVE DECLARED FOR A MAMMOTH 713/9! Almost all the Lankan batsmen made merry on the surface which is not like the one we see in the sub-continent. Daddy hundreds from Dhananjaya de Silva and Kusal Mendis set the tone for them as they amassed a record 308-run stand. After their departure, Roshen Silva and Dinesh Chandimal stepped in. The former helped himself to his maiden Test ton while his skipper missed out by 13 runs. Once the visitors went ahead of the hosts, Niroshan Dickwella with his aggressive approach, scored a quickfire 62 off 61 balls to keep the leather hunt going.

OUT! Plumb! Flighted delivery, landed around off, Rangana Herath gets down to sweep it away but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal has been raised to which the umpire raises his finger. Herath asks his partner whether to take the DRS but gets a negative response.
Flatter again around off, RH prods forward to defend and gets beaten.
FOUR!streaky Flatter and shorter in length outside off, Herath looks to cut it away but gets a thick edge which flies past the first slip fielder for a boundary. LEAD now touches 200.
Kumara drives this tossed up ball back to the bowler.
Kumara goes back and wrists it through mid-wicket with the turn.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loops it up outside off, Herath drives it through cover for a single.
Pitches it around off and then spins away to beat the outside edge.
Flighted ball outside off, pushed towards the point fielder.
Mehidy Hasan to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Kumara lunges forward to defend but it goes off the edge towards short third man.
Wider outside off, Kumara goes after it. Gets it though the gap at cover and he's off the mark too. Karunarante will be cursing after seeing this.
Flighted ball outside off, Lahiru prods ahead in defense.
Lahiru Kumara is the new man in.

OUT! Knocked him over! Islam loops it up on the stumps, Lakmal shuffles across to send it out of Bangladesh but misses it completely. The ball sneaks through the disturb the furniture behind. Third wicket for Islam but he's not even celebrating.
Gets down and unfurls a reverse sweep through backward point for a single.
Floated delivery outside off, blocked off the front foot.

Was that even a break? Couldn't even get a breather. Well, I shouldn't be complaining as this is something which is my profession. And I love it. 31 overs remain in the day. Rangana Herath to face the first ball.
... Day 4, Session 3 ...

Sri Lanka continue to mount the runs. They have stretched the lead to almost 200 and still have 3 wickets left. The session saw Bangladesh picking three wickets - Chandimal, Dickwella and Perera - but to be honest it hasn't done any good to them. Their bowlers have bowled 197 OVERS and this shows how much they have been made to work for wickets. The pitch has started to show some tricks although not that alarming. In all likelihood Bangladesh would be the last one batting on this and with the scoreboard pressure already up there, it would be interesting to see how they fare. All that for later, first Sri Lanka should declare or get bowled out. Join us back for the final session of the day, to see if things change...
Floated delivery around off, Lakmal works it off the inner half towards square leg. TEA ON DAY 4, SRI LANKA LEAD BY 192!
Bowls a loopy leg break, it's pitched outside leg and beats Lakmal's back foot defense.
Lakmal presses forward in defense.
Flighted outside off, driven towards cover.
Tossed up further outside off, Rangana eases it through cover for a single.
Flatter and it stays a bit low, Herath hangs back in defense.
Is get into the position early and reverse sweeps it through backward point for a single.
Flatter through the air on middle, Herath hangs back in defense.
Tucked into the leg side for a single.
Comes down the track to work it away but misses to get hit on the pads. Stifled appeal which is instantly turned down.
Gets forward and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated delivery outside off, spinning back in, Herath flicks it with the spin towards square leg.
Taijul Islam is back on.

Lakmal has made it in comfortably! Herath once again clips it away towards the leg side and this time the Lankan vice captain calls through for a single. The fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end and once again the TV umpire is asked for some help. Replays roll in and it shows the batsman is home.
Flatter through the air around middle, defended from within the crease.
There is another appeal for a run out this time against Lakmal. Looks safe again!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets forward and blocks it out.

NOT OUT! Easily in! Herath works it with the spin towards mid-wicket and sets off for a single before asking to go back. The man there dives to stop and returns a throw to Liton Das who takes the bails off and appeals. They take it upstairs and first replay is enough for the TV umpire to announce his decision.
TV umpire is called for a run out appeal against Herath. Looks safe.
Around middle and leg, clipped towards the man at square leg.
Negotiated with a drive to mid on.
The leg spinner around middle and off, blocked off the front foot.
Floated on the stumps, swept away through square leg for one. 700 up for the visitors, the lead 13 shy of 200.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Floated around middle and off, Herath lunges forward to defend but misses. The ball strikes him high on the front pad. The players appeal and the umpire shakes his head. Height the factor.
Full around off, driven through mid off for a single.
Tossed up around off, Rangana misses the flick and gets hit on the front pad. A huge appeal follows, turned down. Rod Tucker says it is sliding down leg.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Swept away fine down the leg side for one. The lead moves up to 184 now.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off for one.
Tossed up around off, reverse swept through backward point for one.
Tossed up outside off, driven off the inner half back to the bowler. Lazy effort from Sunzamul and he lets it through. A run taken.
Another ball blocked with a prod forward.
Slower through the air around middle and off, blocked.
Similar delivery, similar set of actions from the batter.
Herath prods forward and blocks it off the front foot.
On the pads, nudged towards short fine leg
Floated on a fuller length, eased down to long on for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Serves it down the leg side, Herath goes back to flick but misses. Das takes it by moving to his right.
Slower and fuller outside off, eased down to long on for a single.
Loopier ball outside off, Suranga presses forward in defense.
This is the shot he plays well! Loopy delivery around middle and leg, Herath reverse sweeps it through backward point for a single.
Flighted ball around middle and off, worked with the spin towards square leg.
Bowls a leg break, skids off the deck, Lakmal goes back to tuck it away but misses to get hit on the pads.
Dances down the track and bunts it back to Hasan.
Gets down and slog sweeps it aerially over mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, RH gets forward to keep it out.
Loopy delivery outside off, Ranagana pushes it towards cover, Lakmal wants a single but is sent back.
Flighted full ball outside off, worked away towards mid on for a single.
On the bounce! Loopy delivery around middle and leg, Herath gets down and sweeps it on the bounce to short leg.
Tossed up wider outside off, worked down to long on for a single.
Lakmal presses forward in defense.
Suranga Lakmal is the new man in.

OUT! Dead duck! Sri Lanka lose Perera and with him a review too! Nicely tossed up on the stumps, it skids off the deck as Perera goes back to flick it away. Misses to get hit on the pads right in front of the stumps. A loud appeal and umpire Rod Tucker raises his finger. Dilruwan still takes the review and Hawk Eye returns three reds! Sunzamul Islam opens his account in Test cricket! Sri Lanka are 26 short of a 200-run lead.
Perera has been given out LBW! Looks to be a dead duck but he takes the review.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Flattish delivery on middle and off, defended off the back foot back to Mehidy.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Down the leg side, Herath tries to do what Dickwella did and got out. A reverse sweep but the only difference here was Herath misses it completely.

FOUR! Bowls a half-tracker on middle, Perera has all the time in the world to go back and dispatch. He does so and takes the lead to 172.
Flicked straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
A loud appeal but it was easily going down leg! Quicker and angling in, DP misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. They appeal long and hard but Hawk Eye shows it is going down leg.

FOUR! Thwacked! Flighted delivery outside off, Dilruwan gets down and gives it a full swing of the bat against the turn. Mistimes it but there is no one in the deep mid-wicket region and he gets a boundary. Lead moves to 168!
The short leg fielder has copped a blow from Herath. He looks to be in some agony and understandably so. The physio is out to attend him. It's Mosaddek Hossain. Ouch!
Floated ball outside off, Perera gets down and sweeps it off the meat but it hits the short leg fielder on the right boot and deflects towards mid-wicket for a single.
Spinning down leg, Dilruwan goes back to flick but misses to wear it high on the pads.
Perera covers the line to the quicker ball and defends it with a straight bat.
On a flatter trajectory, Perera hangs back in defense.
Flighted ball outside off, Dilruwan prods forward to defend but the ball spins back in to ping him on the pads.
On middle and leg, worked away towards mid on.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
Loopy ball around middle and off, RH presses forward in defense.
Quicker and flatter outside off, slapped square of the wicket on the off side for one.
Another short ball, lucky that Perera hits it straight to the same fielder.
Flatter and served outside off, punched off the back foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Down the leg side, it's a dipping full toss, Herath helps it with a sweep through fine leg for a single.
Floats it up around middle, swept straight to the man at square leg.
Worked through square leg and takes a single this time.

The dive saves Perera! Slider around middle and leg, Rangana misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards square leg. The keeper himself gets to the ball and Perera is more than halfway down the track in search of a single. Rangana sends him back as Das fires a wide throw at the bowler's end. Hasan collects and takes the bails off as Dilruwan dives to get back in. It's taken upstairs and replays show that the batsman has made it in.
A run out appeal is taken upstairs. Looks safe though.
Quicker ball, landed outside off, Herath plants his front foot across and makes a leave.
Down the leg side, Herath misses his flick.

Drinks!
Safely negotiates the final ball by blocking it from the crease.
DP hangs back to this one and blocks it out.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Perera rotates strike by playing this through the point region.

Flicked away towards square leg for nothing.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Dilruwan gets ahead and bunts this one.

FOUR! Tired bowling hands, leaking runs. Hasan darts this short and outside off, Perera goes back and punches it through covers for a boundary. Sri Lanka 155 ahead.
Eased through mid off for one to retain strike.

DP prods forward and blocks it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Kept out with a straight bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sunzamul Islam to bowl.
Flicked away straight to square leg.
Appeal again. Served in line of the stumps, Herath lunges forward to block. Misses and the ball goes off his pads towards slip. The players appeal to no avail. Sliding down leg.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker one on the pads, Rangana fails to flick it away and gets hit low on the pads.

Another appeal, turned down. Sliding down leg, indicates the umpire. Flatter one on the stumps, Herath misses the flick and gets rapped on the knee roll. The players go up in celebration but are cut short by the umpire's decision.
Rangana Herath makes his way out next.

OUT! Mehidy strikes! Floated down the leg side, Dickwella looks to play the reverse sweep. He has to fetch it from outside the leg stump. Cannot manage to do so and ends up feathering an edge to the keeper. The bowler is as ecstatic as he would be when he picks up a fifer! Talk about living by the sword and dying by it...
Defended solidly off the front foot.
Dilruwan misses cutting this one away.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Around off, Dickwella goes back to block but gets it off the inside edge through the vacant short leg area for one. This partnership reaches 50 now. Apart from the opening stand, all the others have gone on to cross the mark. THE LEAD TOUCHES 150 NOW.

FOUR! Impressive. There was a third man in place as an insurance against the reverse sweep that the southpaw plays. But he goes ahead with the shot and gets it in front of square on the off side for a boundary. Clever. Niroshan Dickwella.
Full outside off, driven through covers for one.

Floated full down the leg side, Dickwella sweeps it to short fine leg and comes down in search of a run. Is sent back and he gets in. The throw is fired at the striker's end that uproots the left-hander's leg stump. He's safe says Mr. Tucker, even as Kayes signals him to take it upstairs.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Quicker one on middle and leg, kept out towards mid off.
ND prods forward to defend this one.
Straighter on the stumps, defended off the back foot.
Floated in a line outside leg, Dickwella goes back to flick but gets it off the outer half towards the bowler.
Flatter outside off, Dilruwan goes back and cuts it past backward point for a brace. Lead - 144.
Tapped towards covers for one.
Driven back to the bowler.
Dilruwan drives this through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flicked away off the pads for a single.

In dipping arm delivery angling in, Perera fails to get bat to that and wears it on the front pad. The players appeal even as the ball goes towards point. The umpire stays unmoved. The batters cross to the other end. A shy is had at the bowler's end but it misses the stumps. Leg byes signaled. The ball was sliding down leg.
Swept fine down the leg side for a couple.
Blocked off the front foot.

FOUR! Deft! Flatter ball just outside off. There is not much width on offer. Dickwella goes back and plays it delicately past slip. The ball goes away to the third man fence in a flash. Brings up the 8th Test fifty for him. Yet again like always, he has helped Sri Lanka gain momentum since he came out to the middle.
Pushed through mid on for one.
Quicker one outside off, it goes on with the arm. Perera fails to cut it away.
Landed outside off, Dilruwan lunges forward and presses it onto the ground.
Flighted ball fuller in length, Niroshan hits it back to the bowler.
Perera goes back to this one and works it past short leg for one.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, pushed to point.
Nudged through mid-wicket for a single that takes him to 49.
FOUR! Floated delivery around off, Dickwella charges down and takes it on the full. Hits it through covers for another boundary.
Taijul to bowl his 63rd over. He is second in the list of most overs bowled by a Bangladeshi bowler in an innings, behind Shakib Al Hasan, who has the record for bowling 66 overs.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Perera stands back and blocks it.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked away through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Audacious! Tossed up outside off, Dickwella gets down and unfurls the reverse sweep. The ball races away to the third man fence to take him to 43 off just 42 balls. The lead is now 124.
Perera goes to the other end after taking a single through mid on.
ND charges down the wicket. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Streaky but Perera won't mind. A flighted ball outside off, he looks to drive it square on the off side. Gets a thick outside edge past slip and goes away to the fence behind.
Floated full outside off, DP looks to drive but misses it.
Darted on the pads, Dilruwan misses the flick and wears it on the pads.
Floated up on off, milked through mid on for one.
Flatter outside off, ND goes back to cut but misses.
Around off, eased through mid off for one.
Floated on the stumps, swept straight to short fine leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flicked away through square leg for a single.

Judicious use of the review SAVES Perera! NOT OUT is the decision! Floated up around off, Perera comes down the track and looks to go big over the on side. But the ball stays very low, goes under the bat and hits him on the back pad. On an appeal being put up, the finger is raised. Dilruwan immediately makes use of the DRS. There is no inside edge, as confirmed by Snicko. Hawk Eye takes ages to come up and when it does, it shows the ball to be SPINNING DOWN LEG. Hush! So much turn on that.
Perera is a goner! He is ruled out LBW but he chooses to challenge it immediately. An inside edge? Only that can save him.
Pushed outside off, Niroshan drives it to sweeper for one.

FOUR! BAM! Tossed up outside off, it is on a fuller length. Dickwella gets down on a knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary. He moves to 36 off just 35 balls. Sri Lanka get ahead by 110 runs.
Quicker and straighter on the pads, flicked through square leg for a couple.
Turn. From the rough. Floated outside off, the ball lands in THAT area and spins away past the outside edge and the keeper's gloves towards first slip.
Islam tosses it wider outside off, Dickwella goes back and steers it towards third man and gets to the other end.
Shorter outside off, punched away to deep backward point for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Floated full around off and middle, Perera bunts it off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, Perera guides it towards third man for one.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Short leg in the firing line. Short in length, Dilruwan goes back and pulls it but it hits the man at bat-pad and stops.
Perera gets forward and blocks it off the front foot.
Floated on the stumps, turned away off the pads for one.
Dickwella sees this off with a forward defense.
Mehidy Hasan will roll his arm over from the other end.
Perera hangs on the back foot and blocks it. A run and a wicket from it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another one? An inside edge saves him perhaps. Floated around off and middle, Perera gets an inside edge onto the pads as he looks to defend this with a lunge. A huge appeal follows, turned down.
Dilruwan Perera walks in next. He will have a bigger role to play later on with the ball.

OUT! Turn and spin were the talks of the town since morning and it's the one that doesn't turn does the trick. Taijul floats in an arm delivery around off and it goes on with the arm. Chandimal looks to play the drive with the turn, which was absent, and ends up getting beaten on the inside. The ball goes onto have a meeting with the woodwork behind, that stops the Lankan skipper from progressing further. Half the visiting side back in the hut after being ahead by exactly the three-figure mark.
Around off, pushed to covers for nothing.
Floated around off, Niroshan gets down the track and eases it down the track for one.

Hello! It's good to have you back with us. The home side is having a small huddle beyond the fence before making their way out. They would believe that this is a session for them to bundle the tourists out. Out walk Dinesh Chandimal and Niroshan Dickwella with the bat. Their aim would be to extend their lead to as much as they can. The latter will face Taijul Islam first up. Let's play, says Rod Tucker!
... Penultimate Day, Penultimate Session ...

The track has shown enough today for us to suggest that it has woken up from the slumber that it had gone into for the past three days. Given the way things stand, the tourists will look to add another century of runs to their kitty before they let their spinners out at the hosts like mice from a sack. Join us back in a while, for what we believe, would be an intriguing session of Test cricket.

Bangladesh, for once, did the right thing by handing the ball to Mehidy Hasan at the start. Although not immediately, he did show what his side missed yesterday by not doing so. The deliveries bowled outside off spun in a mile to catch the well-set batters off guard. Although it was only after the first hour, that he succeeded in picking up a scalp, the seeds of doubt were sown well before. Taijul Islam, too, got good purchase from the surface and he should have been sitting with another victim to his list, had the sharp chance offered by Niroshan Dickwella in the penultimate over before Lunch been taken.

In spite of some action happening towards the end of this session, no soul on this land has a doubt about who is ahead at this point. There are roughs outside the area of the stumps on the track. If the bowlers landed it on those spots, the batters were beaten, appeals were put up, hands were raised from the bowlers only to quickly come down in despair. Amidst all this, Dinesh Chandimal has quietly accumulated runs, like a monk meditates calmly unmindful of all the raucous happening around. He is 13 short of the triple-figure mark. Roshen Silva showed a demeanour of a veteran to notch up his maiden Test ton. Ironically, it is just his second game in the longest format.

Four Byes! Lovely delivery. Shows that the track has a thing or two for the spinners if they land the ball in the right areas. Hasan tosses it outside off, it lands in the rough and comes back in. Chandimal looks defend with a lunge forward but gets beaten on the inside. The ball beats the keeper to his left and goes away to the fence behind. Sri Lanka lead by 99 at LUNCH ON THE PENULTIMATE DAY!
Last ball before lunch...
Blocked off the front foot onto the ground.
FOUR! Classic shot! Shorter and flatter outside off, Chandimal goes back and slaps it through covers for a boundary. The lead moves to 95 now.
Flatter on the pads, ND misses the flick and the ball goes off his pads to the on side for a leg bye.
Chandimal flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! Another one, three-in-three. Tossed up outside off, swept away again. This time it goes just over the man at square leg and goes to the fence. Brings up the 600 for the visitors.  As fickle as the occasion makes it seem, the 50-run stand is raised as a result.
FOUR! Rubbing salt to the wounds. Floated around off, Dickwella gets down and unfurls the sweep shot. The ball speeds away to the deep square leg fence.

FOUR! ANOTHER CHANCE! Gone abegging. Bangladesh aren't grabbing the opportunities coming their way. Islam slides in a quicker one outside off, it skids on after pitching. Dickwella goes back to defend but gets a thick outside edge that flies between the keeper and the slip for a boundary. Kayes was late in reacting in the latter position. Tino Mawoyo on air makes a valid point immediately. He states that since the ball is fairly new, the slip fielder should have realised that the ball will come to him quicker and hence should have stood a bit finer. Little things, they matter a lot.
ND stays back and presents a straight bat.
Floated full outside off, Dickwella gets down to sweep but misses. He gets hit on the back thigh. The bowler puts in an appeal and withdraws it soon as the impact was well outside off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
DC pushes this one to mid-wicket.
Served on the pads, worked away to the on side.
BOUNCE! Flatter outside off, Chandimal goes back to cut it but gets beaten as the ball lifts up from the rough.
Floated around off, Dinesh gets down the track and pushes it to mid on for nothing.
Flighted ball outside off, Chandimal punches it back to the bowler from the crease.
Shortish in length outside off, Dinesh punches it through covers to take strike for the next over. The visitors are 77 runs ahead in the game. Around 9 minutes left for Lunch.
Tossed up on a fuller length, Dickwella gets down the track and works it away through mid-wicket to get to the other end.
Bowled on a flatter trajectory outside off, Chandimal stays back and slaps it through cover-point to rotate strike.
Flighted ball around middle, flicked past short leg for one.
Chandimal slinks down and gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
Floated on off, defended with a prod forward.
Taijul Islam replaces the Fizz now.
Around off, blocked off the front foot onto the ground.
Dickwella shimmies down the track and blocks.
Flatter outside off, ND misses out on the cut shot.

FOUR! This was always coming, wasn't it? A spinner against Dickwella, the attacking shot was always around the corner. He gets down and nails the sweep shot in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, cut away through point for one.

DROPPED? Very good effort from Das, but unfortunately for him, the answer to the question will be affirmative. Chandimal gets down to paddle sweep to this delivery bowled around off. Liton anticipates that and begins to move to his left. Does well to get there as Dinesh plays the shot. The keeper sticks his gloves to his left but the ball just hits him on the left glove and rolls to the leg side. These are the ones that stick. Unlucky Mehidy.
Back of a length outside off, Dinesh cuts it to deep backward point to retain strike.
WIDE! Rahman comes round the wicket and bangs in a bumper. Chandimal ducks as Das takes it with a leap. Mr. Tucker stretches his arms.
Short and wide, slapped to deep backward point for one.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards covers for one.

Another short ball, pulled through backward square leg. The fine leg fielder gets to his right to keep it to one. But the throw is a bit wild, prompting Mehidy from second slip to run all the way towards covers to collect that.
On a length outside off, ND times his punch to perfection and gets a brace.
Bouncer outside off, Dickwella stands still and goes for the pull but misses.
Flatter and quicker on the leg, Chandimal goes back to pull but misses. Gets hit on the pads and Mehidy goes up in appeal. Going down leg.
Floated around middle, driven towards mid on for nothing.
Fuller outside off, eased through covers for another couple.
Worked with the spin towards mid on.
Around off and middle, turned through the on side for a brace.

ALMOST GONE! Floated outside off, Dickwella ends up pushing it aerially to the left of silly point. The man there sticks his left hand out but just manages to get a faint fingertip to it. The ball goes further and a run is taken.
The third new ball has been TAKEN. Let me sound cliched - will Bangladesh manage to make inroads now?
This ball is pushed to mid-wicket for nothing.
Length ball on the shorter side, slapped through cover-point for a couple. Good running yet again. The lead has swollen to 55.
Remember, the third new ball is already due now. Bangladesh haven't opted for it yet though.
Length ball well outside off, Dickwella reaches out and places it through point. A single is all he gets.
Sprayed full down leg, Niroshan gets inside the line and misses the flick.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for one.
Fuller on the pads, ND misses the flick and the ball rolls to the on side. A leg bye taken.
Well wide outside off, left alone.
Niroshan gets down the track and milks it to long off. A run taken. SRI LANKA ARE FIFTY RUNS AHEAD NOW.
This one is worked to the on side.

HUGE APPEAL! Hasan is generous in giving the ball some more air on this occasion. Lands it around middle. Dickwella gets down to sweep but misses and wears it on the chest. The home side players scream their hearts out to no avail. Hawk Eye says that it would have returned umpire's call as the ball would have clipped the bails.
Floated on the stumps, defended towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, pushed towards covers.
The third new ball will be due after the following over.
Good shot. Full outside off, Chandimal strides forward and drives it through covers for a brace. Tamim does the mopping up there. The lead swells to 49 now.
Length ball outside off, punched straight to point.
Wristy. On a length angling in, Chandimal hangs back and uses his wrists to flick it away through square leg for a brace.
Comes round the wicket for Chandimal and bowls it on a length outside off. DC keeps it out towards point and shouts a big NOOO!
Hurled outside off, Dickwella pushes it through cover-point for one less than a brace.
Length ball outside off, punched through the cover region for one.
Outside off, reverse swept to third man for one. No maidens yet for Mehidy.
Straighter outside off, shouldered arms to by DC.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Talk about working the batsman over. Three deliveries before eventually dismissing Silva, Hasan kept bowling around the off stump. The wicket ball was the widest of them all, thereby lighting up Roshen's eyes to go for the run-taking cut shot. Edged and gone followed.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short leg? Absent. Tossed up around off, Chandimal looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads and through the vacant short leg region.
Full around leg, ND sweeps it to fine leg and gets to the other end.
Outside off, kept out to point. Bangladesh sense an opening here. Their body language seems to have changed with Silva's wicket.
Landed around off, driven back towards the bowler.
Hurled in line of the stumps, defended towards mid on.

A cover drive through mid-wicket! Yes, you read that right. Fuller in length just outside off, Dinesh looks to drive it through the off side. The ball goes off the inside edge towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Around off, defended from the crease.

Intent from Chandimal. Rahman bowls it outside off from round the wicket, the skipper pushes it through cover-point. Takes the first run very quickly and that allows him to come back quickly for another.
Mustafizur Rahman is brought back into the attack.
Tossed up on a fuller length on middle, Niroshan gets down and sweeps it fine down the leg side. Hasan sits appealing for LBW, although it came off the bat. A couple results.
Floated around off, Dickwella lunges forward and defends.
Niroshan Dickwella, the swashbuckling left-hander, walks out to the middle. Hold on to your hats, we could be in for some quick runs here. A silly point comes in as well.

OUT! STOP THE PRESS! Mehidy Hasan provides the breakthrough for the hosts. All this while, he was getting significant purchase when he was landing it outside off but not so if he ventured closer to the stumps. Perhaps he realised it late and as they say, better late than never. He bowls it flatter outside off on a shorter length, Silva goes back to cut it away. But the ball lands on the rough and goes straight on, taking the bottom edge on the way to the keeper. That culminates a good level-headed knock from Roshen Silva, thereby ending the 135-run association that he had with his skipper. His side is 37 runs ahead at this point. Another view could be, his wicket could be a blessing in disguise for Sri Lanka as he wasn't really looking like scoring quickly. The men to follow could take an aggressive approach here.
Around middle and leg, flicked away to the on side.
Around off, spinning in a bit, Roshen closes the bat face and plays it to backward square leg.
Served around off, Silva lunges forward and keeps it out.
Drinks are on the field.
Loopy ball outside off, Dinesh comes down the track and strokes it straight to the cover fielder.
Flatter through the air, Chandimal goes back and pats it towards the cover fielder.
Darted on the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Loopy full toss, dipping in, Chandimal comes down the track to take it on the full to whip it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely uses his feet and eases it down to long off for a single.
Floats it up outside off, allows the ball to turn and then taps it in front of point for a single.
Nice flight on this one, fuller outside off, the batsman prods forward in defense.
Fuller on off, pushed through cover for a single.
The Lankan skipper dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Stays back and tucks it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Spinning back in from outside off, it stays a bit low. DC keeps it out.
Chandimal shimmies down the track and flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
Goes wide of the crease and slides in an arm ball, Roshen presses forward and defends it down the ground.
Dances down the track and jams it out back to Islam.
Loopy delivery outside off, played off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Turns away from a length, Silva hangs back in defense.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Chandimal punches it past cover for one.
Flattish ball on the stumps, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Loopy delivery outside off, worked with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Flatter through the air, punched off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Bowls it quicker and shorter outside off, Silva goes back to cut but isn't in any control. Gets it towards backward point and they take the single.
Around middle and leg, wristed towards the leg side.
Silva flicks it through the leg side for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Was it off the pads? Well, Bangladesh certainly feel so! Quicker and flatter through the air outside off, Silva looks to cut but it goes off something and deflects off Das' gloves towards third man. The batsmen are busy running but the bowler appeals for an LBW. The umpire signals it as runs. Replays later on show that it was off the pads but the impact could have been an issue. Since, the hosts have exhausted their reviews, story over.
Quicker ball on the stumps, blocked off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Drops it short outside off, Chandimal taps it towards cover and calls through for a single.
Slower through the air, fuller in length, blocked.

A huge appeal! Tossed up on the rough outside off, Silva takes a stride forward to defend but the ball spins back in to hit him on the pads. The umpire, however, shakes his head as the impact was outside the line.
Loopy delivery outside off, Silva leans forward and wrists it to short leg.
Goes back and flicks it towards mid-wicket.

This isn't impressive. From the Dutch Bangla End from which Hasan is bowling at the moment, there are plenty of rough patches outside the off stump of the right-hander. But he's not bowling there. If he continuously lands it on that, he could cause some trouble.
Eases it towards mid off for gets to the other end.
The bottom hand comes off! Tossed up on middle, Chandimal comes down the track to go inside out but the bottom hand comes off but still he connects it well to clear the man at mid off. Takes a brace.
Quicker through the air, clipped off the back foot to short leg who takes it on the bounce.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Keeps it full outside off, blocked into the ground.
Beaten! Flighted delivery outside off, Roshen goes back to defend but the ball spins away past the outside edge.
Spinning down leg, swept down to fine leg for a single.
Islam drops it short outside off, Silva punches it towards mid off who is placed a bit deep. Easy single for RS.
On middle and leg, wristed towards short mid-wicket.
A bit shorter, turning back in, punched comfortably off the back foot past short mid-wicket for one.
There you go, Mehidy! Pitches it on the rough, Chandimal leans forward to drive but gets it off the inner half past the man at short leg for a single.
Comes down the track and pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Flicks it with the turn through mid-wicket for a single.
Another batsmen making the most of it! It's Chandimal who reaches to his fifty, 16th in Tests! Gets across and flicks it through square leg for a single.
On a flatter trajectory, punched towards cover for a single.
Chandimal dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Gets down and across to broom it away towards fine leg for another couple.

Beats the backward point and runs three! Maiden Test ton for Roshen Silva! It means a lot to him. Removes the cap, raises both his arms in delight and gets a huge hug from Chandimal. Very well played! Flatter again outside off, easy for Silva who gets back and steers it through backward point. The fielder gives it a chase and slides to stop the ball but by the time he returns a throw Silva is already seen celebrating.
Flatter delivery outside off, Silva cuts it behind point and runs brace. Moves to 97!
Tossed up ball outside off, Roshen Silva presses forward and taps it towards point. Wants the single but Chandimal sends him back.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket.

Another huge shout! Pitched outside off, turning back in off the surface and beating the back foot defense of Silva. He gets hit on the pads and an appeal follows. Not given as it seemed to have gone down leg.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Gently tossed up outside off, Silva is happy to keep it out.
Chandimal presses forward to a loopy ball and pats it towards point for a single.
Leans forward to push it away but gets it off the outer half as the ball rolls away towards point.
More flight on this one but the length is too full which allows the batsman to drive it towards cover and take the single.
Gets well forward and stonewalls it.
Nicely bowled! Gives it nice loop, lands it outside off and turns away sharply to beat the attempted drive of the Lankan skipper. Keep bowling on that length.
Flighted ball outside off, Chandimal comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery outside off, pushed into the cover region.
Helmets off, caps on for both the batsmen. Also, Rahman is taken off and here comes Taijul Islam.
A bit shorter, turning back in, clipped towards the leg side.
Around middle and leg, RS works it to short mid-wicket.

Oh encouraging turn for Hasan! A loopy off break, pitched outside off and turning back in, Silva comes forward to defend but misses to get pinged on the pads. A stifled appeal from the bowler. The impact was well outside the line.
Loopy delivery outside off, Chandimal milks a single down to long on.
Tossed up ball on the stumps, RS clips it through mid-wicket with soft hands and scampers through to the other end.
Flighted delivery around middle, Roshen comes forward and wrists it off the inner half to short fine leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another fuller delivery on off, Chandimal strides forward and defends it straight to the short cover fielder.

Very unusual of Chandimal! Sees the fuller delivery, it's a bit wider on off, the Lankan skipper couldn't resist as he looks to spank it through the line. Gets beaten completely. A moral victory for Rahman?
Pitches it right up there, it's the cutter again, a nice compact defense from DC.
Good length delivery, angling in, DC prods forward to block it towards the cover fielder.
Sprays a bit wider outside off, Chandimal lifts his bat to make a leave.
Shimmies down the track to a loopy ball and pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Flatter through the air around off, blocked.
Roshen Silva works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end to raise another 100-run stand of the Lankan innings. Handshakes between the batsmen as they get back to business.
Tossed up delivery outside off, blocked off the front foot watchfully.
Around middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Turning back in from a length outside off, clipped towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Sri Lanka get into the lead! Shortish of a good length outside off, Silva taps it in front of point and calls through for a quick single.
The Fizz bowls it fuller outside off, it's left alone.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Takes a little stride forward and strokes it straight to mid off.

FOUR! Lovely! Rahman delivers it on a fuller length outside off, Silva reaches out to that one and square drives it through backward point. Fetches a boundary to level the scores and move into the 90s.
Fuller in length and around off, Silva is rock solid in defense.
Loopy ball outside off, defended off the front foot.
Floated ball outside off, defended by coming down the track. Best way to keep the spinners at bay.
Skips down the track to kill the spin and pushes it to mid on.

FOUR! Rolls his wrists is what my colleague says as soon as Chandimal unfurled a sweep shot! I was busy describing the LBW shout and couldn't spot that! Flighted delivery around middle, Chandimal gets across and sweeps it neatly to play it along the ground towards fine leg. Tamim Iqbal in the deep tries to stop but to no avail. Also, it brings up the 100 for Mehidy Hasan. Partnership moves to 94 and trail reduces to just 4.
Goes back and clips it on the bounce to short leg.

A loud, loud shout for an LBW! Hasan floats it up around middle and off, Chandimal gets down to play the sweep shot but it goes off something and dies down besides the short leg fielder. Mehidy turns back and keeps appealing but umpire Erasmus shakes his head. Bangladesh don't have any reviews left. Replays show it was a good call from the umpire as it went off the gloves.
Mehidy Hasan Miraz to bowl from the other end.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched towards cover for a single to end the first over.
Cutter but at a good pace, 131 clicks. The line is a bit wider which allows the Lankan skipper to leave it alone.
Switches the angle and comes from around the wicket. He hurls in a cutter, in the channel outside off, DC stays back and pushes it towards the point fielder.
Good shot but for nothing! Fuller in length, outside off, Chandimal leans into it and drives it towards wide mid off where the fielder makes a good stop.
Slightly fuller, pitched around the fourth stump line, defended off the front foot gently.
Begins with a fuller length delivery, a bit wide outside off. Chandimal ain't interested in going after that one.

We are all set to get underway. There is a Bangladesh team huddle near the boundary rope. Out walk the Sri Lankan overnight batsmen - Roshen Silva and Dinesh Chandimal. It will be Mustafizur Rahman to kickoff the proceedings. Let's roll...

The Bangladesh skipper is up for a quick chat. Mahmudullah says his bowlers tried hard but aren't getting any assistance off the wicket. Feels even they are a bit surprised as to why is there very little turn on offer. Hopes that the pitch might break out and they manage to pick up wickets to get back into the game.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo says the pitch is still the same with very little wear and tear. Adds there have been some roughs outside the off stump for both left and right-handed batsmen which needs to be exploited.

Bangladesh need to pick wickets and bowl the visitors out if they are to restrict the Lankans from running away with the show. If that doesn't happen, the hosts will be under the pump. Also, if at all the pitch deteriorates and Sri Lanka get a lead of around 150-200, Mahmudullah and his men will be having their backs against the wall. How will day 4 pan out? Welcome for the coverage of the first Test...

It's been a batting paradise at Chittagong that we have got to witness so far in the first three days. Bangladesh posted a huge first innings total and in reply Sri Lanka have almost reached there and they have a full week of wickets left in the bank. With Roshen Silva and Dinesh Chandimal out there and with Niroshan Dickwella yet to come, one would expect them to continue the juggernaut.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

So, Sri Lanka are in the driver's seat and would accelerate once they resume their innings tomorrow. As de Silva said, if they get a lead of around 150-200, it will definitely tighten their grip on the match. Generally, day 3 is regarded as the moving day in a Test match but here day 4, could take that role. Will the surface breakout? Or will this game head towards a tame draw? Penultimate day will tell us. Join us at 0930 Local (0330 GMT) to catch all the action. Goodbye and Cheers!

Gautam Bhimani and Roshan Abeysinghe have Dhananjaya de Silva with them for an interview. He says he backs his game, which is all about aggression. Adds Kusal Mendis' role was to rotate strike and that they both complimented each other really well. Further says he and Mendis spoke that all they need is to stand out there as the wicket isn't that difficult to bat on. Is disappointed to not get a double ton especially when he was so close. Feels if they manage to get a lead of around 150-200, they stand a real chance.

Roshen Silva then, along with his skipper, Dinesh Chandimal, continued the pattern. The former made the most of the opportunity given to him as he is all set to get a ton of his own. Importantly, for Sri Lanka they are just one short of 10 behind the hosts' first innings total. Bangladesh, well, they've been made to toil really hard on the field. Mind you, it's not over as yet. Their spinners are not able extract anything off the surface and whatever little that they did, the visitors managed to deal with it. The fact that they could only pick up two wickets today, should tell you the way they have got a beating at the hands of the Lankans.

Sri Lanka's day by a distance! Over 1000 runs being scored for the loss of just 13 wickets in three days, tells us that it was another day where the batsmen have dictated terms. It all started with the overnight duo of Kusal Mendis and Dhananjaya de Silva continuing from where they left off. They kept the hosts firmly on the back foot by bagging a wicketless morning session today. Both of them registered their career-best scores but sadly, departed just when they were nearing a double ton.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Roshen Silva negotiates the last ball by lunging forward. STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Some turn! Lands it outside off, Silva comes forward to defend but the ball turns away as Roshen makes a leave.
Tossed up further outside off, another defense off the front foot.
Takes a stride forward and pushes it to the cover fielder.
Loopy delivery outside off, Roshen lunges forward in defense.
Floated delivery around middle and off, Silva blocks it out.
Last over of the day coming up.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Beaten! Cutter from Mustafizur, Silva dangles his bat at it but the ball shapes away and nearly takes the outside edge.
Bowls a cutter, on a length outside off, punched a bit squarer on the off side to collect two.
Fuller ball on off, defended solidly.
Stays back and shows a straight bat.

What was that from Sunzamul Islam? Lazy effort? Short of a length delivery, angling in on middle, Chandimal looks to pull and does so a bit uppishly towards fine leg. The debutant collects it on the bounce over his head and nearly makes a mess of it as the ball pops out. The balls rolls behind him but he recovers. A single taken.

A loud shout for an LBW! Maybe, sliding down leg! Quicker through the air, skidding off the deck. Silva goes back to flick but misses to get on the pads. A loud appeal follows but umpire Erasmus shakes his head. Replays then show there was an inside edge. Good call!
Slower through the air around middle and off, Roshen pushes it towards point.
500 comes up for Sri Lanka! Loopy ball outside off, Chandimal dances down the track and milks a single to long off.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards short leg who gets a hand to it and parries it towards square leg for a single.
Slower through the air, turning away, Silva defends it into the ground.
Flighted delivery from around the wicket, landed around middle and leg, Silva presses forward to keep it out.
Taijul Islam is back.
Back of a length delivery on off, punched to mid off.
Fuller and on the pads, Chandimal gets across and flicks it towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Fuller in length and outside off, Chandimal presses across and pushes it to the cover region.
Back of a length delivery outside off, steered fine down to third man for a single.
Comes from around the wicket, but it's a bit too straight this time. Chandimal gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket. Good running again as the batsmen pick up three.
Slants it away on a length outside off, Dinesh lifts his bat and lets it be.
Sees the flight does Silva, comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle and leg, worked with soft hands towards the square leg fielder.
Nicely looped up outside off, Roshen Silva takes a little stride forward and defends.
Lunges forward and dead-bats it.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Silva presses forward in defense.
Wider outside off, dabbed towards point and calls his skipper through for a single.
Another cutter this time on middle and leg, Silva misses the flick and wears it on  the pads.

What was he trying to do there? Got beaten or he left it alone? Bowls a cutter, it grips off the surface, Silva at first looks to steer but then it deviates and he keeps his bat inside the line to leave it alone.

FOUR! Easily done! Well played, actually! Length delivery, a bit wide outside off, Roshen stands his ground and places it with an open bat face past the second slip fielder again. Another boundary results and he moves into the 80s!
Slightly fuller and outside off, driven square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Slants it away on a length outside off, Chandimal plants his front foot across and then shoulders his arms.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter and shorter in length outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.
Nicely tossed up outside off, pushed into the cover region.
Leans forward and blocks it into the ground.
Flighted delivery outside off, driven through cover and collects a brace.
Drops it short and outside off, Chandimal cuts it nicely but finds the man at backward point.

FOUR! Just wide of the slip fielder! Back of a length delivery, angling away on the fourth stump channel, Silva steers it delicately past the diving Mehidy Hasan at second slip. No one protecting the third man area and he picks up a boundary.
A bit fuller and around middle and leg, RS misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Fuller in length and outside off, Roshen Silva lifts his bat to make another leave.
Angling away on a length outside off, dabbed towards point.
Wide! Sprays it fuller and miles outside off, it crosses the tramline and it's called as a wide. We saw Lakshan Sandakan bowling a wide in the first innings.
Fuller in length and slanting away outside off, Roshen shoulders his arms to that one.
Strays on the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is called back into the attack. Liton Das is upto the stumps now.
Floated delivery outside off, Dinesh dances down the track but isn't to the pitch of the ball this time. Mistimes it towards Haque who makes another half-stop at short cover. Concedes another single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower through air around middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single.
Flatter through the air outside off, punched towards cover for a single.

Loopy delivery outside off, Chandimal comes down the track and drives it towards Haque at short cover who gets a hand to it and deflects it towards long off. Good running between the wicket allows them to come back for a brace.
Slower through the air, outside off, Chandimal goes back and pushes it towards point.
Just short of the man at short mid-wicket. Floats it up around middle, Silva gets down the track and chips it on the bounce towards Mominul Haque at short mid-wicket.
Chandimal clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Dances down the track and eases it towards mid off for a single.
Gives some more loop, lands it outside off, driven once again back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery outside off, Roshen shimmies down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery around middle and leg, worked towards the man at mid on.
Flighted ball on the stumps, Roshen gets down the track and gets it off the inner half back towards the bowler.
Silva stays in the crease and defends this one.
Almost gone! Tossed up around off, Silva gets down and pushes it uppishly to short cover. It lands just short of Haque there, who takes it with a dive.
Worked away through the square leg region for one.
Bowled in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Floated on middle and leg, worked away through mid-wicket for a single. The trail is down to 43 now.
Fired in line of the stumps, kept out.
Dinesh prods forward and bunts it down.
Darted outside off, punched off the back foot to the cover region.
Floated around off, defended with a stride forward.
Delivered outside off, punched to covers off the back foot.
Shorter outside off, cut away to the man at point.
Flatter outside off, Silva shoulders arms.
Silva dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Roshen lunges forward and defends this.
This is cut to deep backward point for one.
Served well outside off, Dinesh lets it be.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Punched through mid off off the back foot for one.
Outside off, driven through covers for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Chandimal gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to long off for one.
Silva turns this through mid-wicket to move to the other end. That's 50 runs raised between these two. Apart from the first wicket, the stands for the other wickets have all passed at least 50.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter outside off, sliced through backward point for a brace.
On off, defended off the front foot.
Served around middle and leg, turned away in front of square on the leg side to rotate strike. Silva moves to 68 now.
Flatter on the stumps, blocked.
Chandimal gets down the track and pushes it towards long off for one.
Floated on the stumps, defended off the front foot onto the ground.

Drinks are on the field now. This game has crawled in this hour. Sri Lanka haven't shown a great urgency to go about with their task and neither have Bangladesh looked like picking up a wicket. Can they prise out at least one wicket before the end of day's play?
Another one around off, blocked off the front foot. Another maiden over.
This ball is negotiated with a forward defense.
Around middle and leg, turned towards mid-wicket.
Roshen gets down the track and bunts it.
Bowled on the stumps, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Silva charges down and pushes it towards mid off. He takes off for a quick run. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Roshen was well past it.

Roshen Silva has a good front foot defensive technique. He meets the ball with a straight bat face and right under his eye-line. My colleague comments that he absolutely dead-bats them, which ensures that the ball doesn't lob towards the close-in fielders.
Silva dead-bats this one off the front foot.
Blocked off the front foot onto the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Edged but safe! Served around off, Roshen strides forward to block. Gets a soft outside edge to slip on the bounce.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Floated around off, Silva gets down the track and chips it straight over the bowler's head for a biggie.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. A maiden over.
Dinesh stays back and keeps it out.
Floated on the stumps, pushed to mid on.
Another back foot punch, straight to silly point.
Short in length, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Around off and middle, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Chandimal gets down the track and pushes it through covers for one.
Outside off, driven towards covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Lovely ball. Floated outside off, Silva strides forward to defend. Misses the ball as it turns away just a touch. Das misreads the spin as well and the ball hits his gloves and goes to the on side for a bye.
Punched towards covers. But the fielder there parries it to his right and a run is taken.
Patted towards covers for a single that brings up 450 for them. The trail reads 63 now.
On the pads, flicked off the pads for a single.
This ball is punched off the back foot through covers for one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Ouch, the silly point fielder takes a beating with this defensive shot.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Nicely defended off the front foot onto the ground.

Silva pushes it towards mid off and sets off for a run. Chandimal makes it safely to the other end even has the fielder has a shy at hits it directly on the stumps. The ball deflects towards fine leg and another one is taken on the overthrow.
Roshen shimmies down and bunts it stoicly.
Fuller on the stumps, worked away to the on side for a single.
on the stumps, defended towards mid-wicket.
Chandimal gets forward and defends it towards covers.
Silva flicks this one off the pads and gets to the other end. The deficit comes down to 69.
This ball is negotiated with a forward defense.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
On the pads, flicked away through square leg for one.
Roshen defends it nicely off the front foot.
Chandimal lunges forward and pushes it towards covers and gets to the other end.
On the stumps, defended with a straight bat.
This is played towards point off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Roshen defends it with a prod forward.
Dinesh gets down the track and pushes it through covers for one.

FOUR! Finally the binary routine is broken! Tossed up ball around off, Chandimal gets down the track and goes over mid off. The ball goes on the bounce to the fence. This is the first boundary after Tea, and the first after about 13 overs.
Tossed up on off, Dinesh lets it come on and defends it.
Solidly defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Floated around off, pushed towards mid off for a quick run. The man there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
One run taken after charging down the track to flick it towards wide mid on.
Straighter on the stumps, blocked off the inner half towards short leg.
RS gets down the track and dead-bats it.
Floated outside off, stonewalled off the front foot onto the ground.
Chandimal lunges forward to block it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
DC gets to the back foot and keeps it out.
Sunzamul lands it in line of the stumps, bunted off the front foot onto the ground.
Punched through covers for a single.
Outside off, defended off the front foot.
Sunzamul Islam is back for a bowl.
Landed on the pads, worked round the corner to rotate strike.
Chandimal pushes it towards covers and looks to take a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. That enables the skipper to get back in safely.
Tossed up outside off, driven to mid off.
Flatter on off, blocked off the front foot.
Slinks down the track and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Floated up on the stumps, defended after charging down the track.
Making the batsman play this time, defended off the front foot.
Well outside off, Chandimal lets it be.
Rahman comes round the wicket and bowls it just outside off. Play and a miss for DC.

2nd Test fifty in just his third innings for Roshen Silva. Gets a freebie to get to the mark. Full toss angling away, he slices it through point and ambles to the other end. Thanks the Almighty before raising his bat.
Slanting away on a length, Roshen defends it from the crease towards point.
Silva stands back and defends this one solidly.
Quick run! Silva pats it towards mid on and takes on Rahim. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A run completed in the end.
Silva charges down and defends this one.
Flatter around off, Silva goes back and guides it past slip. Comes down in search of a run but has to hurriedly get back as his partner doesn't respond seeing short third man get to the ball quickly.
RS gets down the track and bunts it.
Roshen gets ahead and wrists it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Tossed up on off, defended with a stride forward.
Dinesh stands his ground and blocks it off the front foot.
Hurled in line of the stumps, defended from the crease.
Fuller this time, stabbed through covers for one.

Mustafizur Rahman has bowled on a shorter length after the second new ball has been taken. Inexplicable. Wonder of Courtney Walsh, their bowling coach, has something to do with it. Perhaps, the variable bounce and slowness on the surface would have mooted that tactic.
Around middle and length, driven to mid on.
Outside off, sliced through covers for a couple.
Rahman comes over the wicket and bowls a length delivery around middle and off. Dinesh pushes it with soft hands towards covers and gets to the other end.
Floated on the stumps, Roshen gets down the track and hits it back to the bowler.
Silva charges down and wrists it to mid-wicket.
Defended solidly off the back foot.
Around middle and leg, played to mid-wicket for nothing.
Flatter on the stumps, RS goes back and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Floated around off, defended off the front foot.
Rahman runs in from round the wicket and lands it on a length outside off. Roshen gets squared up a touch but pats it towards cover-point for a quick run. 0,0,0,1,1,1 reads the over.
Milked through covers for one.
Length ball on the pads, tucked away through backward square leg for a single.
Outside off, driven to mid off.
On a length around off, Roshen lets it come on to the bat and blocks it towards mid off.
Fuller in length and angling away, Silva feels for it but misses. The ball goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl from the other end.
DC defends this with a prod forward.
Fuller around off, driven to mid off.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

The Taijul vs Mendis battle was an interesting one. The ball to dismiss the batter was the shortest he bowled to him. Before that, the deliveries were on the good length area on the fuller side. Kusal came ahead and went back to defend those before he decided to take him on and paid the price.
Knocked through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker in pace, in line of the stumps, worked away through square leg for a brace.
Flatter on off, Silva stands there and presents a straight bat to block it.
Welcome back! We have 32 overs left to be bowled. Bangladesh's over rate has hardly been an issue. Roshen Silva will face Taijul Islam to begin the proceedings in this final segment.
... Third Day, Third Session ...

Mendis added over 100 with Roshen Silva, who survived a stumping chance when he came in. The latter has looked composed so far and it is just a matter of time before even he starts to attack. Bangladesh have looked flat on the field, letting runs slip by easily. Add to that the keeper's fumble and some more misfields, you can sense that they are now starting to lose hopes of staying in the game. All's not lost yet, we believe, as if the hosts can make use of the opening that they have got now to eke out few more wickets, they can restrict the opposition from running away with the game. Will we have a batting collapse on the other side of the break or will the bowlers continue to spend more time in the middle? We'll find out shortly.

27 overs, 121 runs, 2 wickets - the numbers that matter. Dhananjaya de Silva and Kusal Mendis began from where they had left off and had a doule hundred for the taking. But just like you shut the lid on the drum after taking water from it, they decided, after getting to 173 and 196 respectively, that they would either get to the coveted figure in style or rather not have it at all. At least that's how it looked on the outset. Both of them fell to rash shots and their side is still three runs less than 100 away from Bangladesh's score.
That's TEA, DAY 3, as this ball outside off is pushed safely towards covers.
Kept out watchfully with a front foot defense towards mid off.
Just outside off, Dinesh just lets it come and defends.
This one is punched towards mid off.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Roshen gets down the track and pushes it towards mid off for one.
Last over before Tea. A slip and a gully in place.
Dinesh sees this off safely with a forward defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off, defended off the front foot.
The Sri Lankan skipper Dinesh Chandimal makes his way out to the center.

NO DOUBLE TON! Mendis gets OUT in an attempt to get to his landmark in a stylish way. Is this a cursed game? After Mominul Haque and Dhananjaya de Silva, now Kusal Mendis misses out on a double hundred. Taijul floats it up but keeps it on a length. Mendis comes down and looks to go big over the on side. Ends up getting a top edge and the ball goes miles in the air. Mushfiqur Rahim runs to his right from mid on and takes a fine catch diving forward after running backwards. Remember, these aren't easy ones. The partnership worth 107 is broken. The youngster was given a couple of chances and he has made good use of them. This is the second time he has been dismissed in the 190s. The tourists are still behind by 98 runs.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Flatter on the pads, Kusal fails to flick it and wears it on the pads.
Taijul Islam back on.
Defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Flatter outside off, pushed to point for one.
Lovely! Tossed up outside off, Kusal looks to play the drive but gets beaten on the outside due to the away spin.
On the stumps, blocked solidly.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the pads, worked away to mid-wicket for one. This is Mendis' Test best score.

FOUR! Oh dear! Another short ball from Mosaddek, put away. Mendis goes back deep in the crease and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. It rolls all along the surface. Now he is just one shot away from a double ton.

SIX! Mendis moves into the 190s in style. Hossain seems to be tired already. After bowling a couple of short balls in the previous over, he drops another one short now. Mendis goes back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen. The 100-run partnership is also raised. The trail comes to double digits.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Flatter on the pads, nudged fine down the leg side for one.
Very full outside off, Kusal fails to jam it out. Well collected by the keeper.
Well outside off, left alone.
Outside off, pushed towards point rotate strike.
Flatter outside off, Silva goes back and glides it towards third man for a couple.
Around off, Silva gets down and bunts it.
Floated outside off, pushed towards covers.
Sunzamul Islam is back on.

FOUR! Same area, same result. This is dropped on a shorter length around middle and leg, Kusal goes back and pulls it. This time, he takes the aerial route and helps himself to another boundary. 9 runs off the over. He moves to 184, the deficit gets down to 114.
FOUR! Short in length, Kusal goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Lots of real estate in that region.
Flatter on the pads, Kusal fails to flick it away.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On the stumps, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Floated around middle and leg, worked away through square leg for one.
Mosaddek Hossain is brought back. He's just bowled the lone over so far.
After getting some protection on the off side, Islam angles this in around middle and leg. Roshen works it through square leg to retain strike. 15 runs off this over. Talk about lack of action now.
Short third man in place, finally. But is it three boundaries too late?

FOUR! Oh Taijul, what line are you bowling with no protection in the deep? Flatter in trajectory, outside off. Silva goes back deep in the crease and he has to only beat the lone slip fielder this time, as the gully is moved to silly point. He does so and collects a boundary.
Eased through covers for a single.

FOUR! Similar ball, similar shot, similar result. Short in length outside off, Mendis goes back and cuts it. There is a gully stationed this time but it doesn't make a difference. The ball goes through his left and speeds away to the fence.

FOUR! Kusal Mendis is in very good touch. Understatement, considering that he is batting on 167 (now 171). This is flatter outside off, Kusal goes back and cuts it powerfully through backward point for a boundary.
Floated on the stumps, Roshen gets down the track and hits it towards mid off for one.
Floated outside off, driven through covers for a couple.
FOUR! Tripe! Half-tracker on the stumps, Kusal goes back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, Kusal goes back and cuts it through backward point for a brace.
Another one outside off, a run taken after pushing it through covers.
A touch short outside off, Mendis hangs on the back foot and pushes it through the cover region for one.
Flatter on the pads, worked away down the leg side for a single.
Roshen eases this one through covers and gets to the other end. The trail gets down to one short of 150.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Flatter outside off, Mendis pushes it towards cover-point for a quick run. The trail gets down to 150 now.
Blocked off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
Mendis prods forward and defends it solidly.
Around middle and leg, pushed to mid-wicket.
On the stumps, patted down the ground for one.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Served around middle and leg, turned through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! That's the fifty-run partnership between these two. Floated full on off, Mendis gets a good stride forward and pushes it down the ground. Beats the bowler and mid off completely and gets a boundary.
Kusal lunges forward and defends this one.
Flatter outside off, guided past slip for a brace. The stand is worth 47 at this point.
RS prods forward and defends.
Roshen gets behind that and keeps it out watchfully.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Lovely. This is a shot similar to the one played by Dhananjaya this morning. Fuller on the stumps, Silva gets down the track and flicks it down through mid-wicket for a boundary. There was a man chasing it but he fails to stop that.
Fuller on off, defended back towards the bowler.
This ball is kept out towards point off the back foot.
On the stumps, turned to mid-wicket for one.
Eased through covers for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, cut towards point.
This one is turned round the corner for nothing.
Mendis lunges forward and blocks.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the pads, flicked away round the corner.
Outside off, pushed to covers.

What's happening? Mendis places this one towards covers and comes down but stops to see what happens to the ball. Hasan there, gets to his left and tumbles as he stops it. Seeing that the ball isn't in the fielder's hands, the batters decide to take a run but then abort the plan. The throw is wide as well as tall, Das has to get well to his right and leap to take that. He does that and also has a shy at the stumps but misses. Kusal puts in the dive and makes it in eventually. A throw closer to the stumps would have meant curtains for him.

Four Byes! Tossed up outside off, Mendis looks to go for the drive. But the turn on that ball takes it past the outside edge and through the gap between first slip and the keeper and goes away to the fence.
Silva prods forward and blocks.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
150 up for Kusal Mendis. This is the third time in his career that he has passed the mark. He goes on the back foot and punches it down to long on for one.

FOUR! All morning, we were ranting as to why Mehidy isn't brought in to bowl and he hasn't been impressive enough after he was. Drops it on a very short length, allowing Mendis to go back and pull it away. He does so and finds the deep mid-wicket fence with ease.
Outside off, pushed defensively towards covers.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Silva goes back and works it off his pads for one.
Mehidy Hasan is brought back.
Drinks are called on the field.
Quicker through the air on middle and leg, RS shimmies down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a single to keep strike.
Dances down the track but almost yorks himself. Digs it out back to Taijul.
Flighted delivery outside off, Silva presses forward in defense.
Drifting in on middle and leg, clipped fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
Loops it up around off, Silva leans ahead and drives it back to Islam.
Very full outside off, jammed out back to the bowler.
Goes wider of the crease and slants it on a fuller length on middle and off, blocked from within the crease. Another good over from The Fizz.
Switches to over the wicket, bowls a lifter on middle and leg. The batsman sits under it to let Liton Das collect.
Short again but the line is down the leg side. KM moves inside the line to leave it unharmed.
Short of a length delivery on middle and off, Kusal Mendis ducks under the bumper quickly.
Short leg comes in place. Expect some short stuff now.
Angling in on a length on middle, Roshen Silva looks to turn it away but it goes off the thigh pad and rolls towards square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Good length delivery, in the channel on uncertainty, Silva shoulders his arms to leave it alone.

Edged but safe! Quicker through the air, at 84.4 kph, it turns away sharply. Mendis hangs back in defense but the away turns takes the outside edge and rolls past the first slip fielder. Kayes gives it a chase to keep them down to a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Mendis eases the drive towards mid off.
Drifting in from outside off, driven towards the fielder at cover.
A bit fuller outside off, worked in front of the short leg fielder.
Flatter one around off, worked in the bounce towards FSL.
Loosener from Taijul! Short and spinning away outside off, Mendis slaps it behind point to take a brace.
We have a change in bowling. Taijul Islam is brought back into the attack. Let's see if the left-arm spinner can extract some purchase with the cherry that is relatively hard.
Back of a length delivery but not much bounce behind it, dealt easily with it.
Fuller in the channel outside off, left alone without much fuss.
Drags his length on the shorter side, Silva doesn't offer any shot.

FOUR! Edgyyyyy! Lucky, that Silva played that with soft hands. Clever bowling from Rahman. He should be happy as he managed to induce an edge! Goes wider of the crease from around the wicket angle, serves a cutter which pitches on off and deviates just a bit. Roshen has a tentative poke at it. Gets an edge which dips in between the first slip fielder and the keeper. Liton Das dives full length to his right but the ball drops in front. It takes a bit of gloves and goes to the fence behind.
Bangs in a short one, at 133 kph, Silva is quick to sit under it.
Good length delivery, angling in, tucked from within the crease towards square leg.

FOUR! That was a loosener! Mehidy Hasan drops it on a shorter length, served outside off, Mendis camps back and punches it through the gap at cover. Rahman in the deep comes charging across to his right, puts in a dive, tries to pull the ball back in play but the ball goes off his fingers and trickles away the fence.
Tossed up delivery outside off, eased through cover for a single.
Gets behind the line and Silva defends it watchfully.
Darted, very full on the stumps, wristed wide of the man at mid on for a single.
Flatter delivery on the stumps, kept out off the back foot gently.
Spinning back down leg, flicked off the pads towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Kusal Mendis hangs back and shows a straight bat. Good couple of overs from Bangladesh. They are drying out the runs here.
Angling in on middle, worked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Hits the deck hard, gets a bit of extra bounce as Roshen Silva ducks under it to let the keeper collect it.
Sprays a bit too wide outside off to make the batter play at it.
Angles it in from outside off, Silva covers the sticks and blocks it down.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped behind point for a single.
Wristed away towards the man at mid-wicket.
Touch short and spinning in from outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Roshen leans ahead and keeps it out.
Tossed up outside off, blocked off the front foot.
Flatter one down the leg side, flicked down to fine leg for a brace.

Stumping chance goes down! Nearly, nearly another one but you can't blame the keeper as he tried his best. Hasan pitches it around middle, Roshen Silva comes down the track but the ball grips and turns down leg. He gets beaten on the attempted flick shot and Liton Das behind the stumps moves quickly to his left but fails to gather. The ball bursts through his mitts and goes behind further.
